function.name: error_exit_fn
function.description: This function handles errors in the jpeg library. It formats the error message and then jumps to the recovery point saved in the client_data of the cinfo structure.

parameters.name: cinfo
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a common jpeg structure. It is used to access the error handler and client data.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return a value. It uses longjmp to transfer control to a different part of the program.

function.name: emit_message_fn
function.description: This function formats and emits a message based on the provided message level. If the message level is less than 0, it treats it as an error. If it's 0, it treats it as a warning. If it's greater than 0, it treats it as a trace message.

parameters.name: cinfo
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a common JPEG structure. It's used to format the message.

parameters.name: msg_level
parameters.description: This parameter determines the level of the message. If it's less than 0, it's an error. If it's 0, it's a warning. If it's greater than 0, it's a trace message.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

parameters.description: Pointer to a decoder structure.

function.name: decoder_from_decompress

function.name: source_mgr_fill_input_buffer
function.description: This function reads from a stream into a buffer, updates the source manager's next input byte and bytes in buffer, and returns a boolean value based on the success of the read operation.

parameters.name: cinfo
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to a decompression structure, which is used to retrieve the jpeg decoder and its associated source manager and buffer.

function.return_type: boolean, where TRUE indicates that the read operation was successful and the source manager's fields were updated, and FALSE indicates that the read operation failed or no bytes were read.

parameters.description: A pointer to the JPEG decompression object.

parameters.description: The number of bytes to skip in the input data.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value.

function.return_type: void, meaning it does not return any value

function.name: jpeg_decoder_initialize
function.description: This function initializes a JPEG decoder, sets up the error handling, reads the JPEG header, determines the color space, starts the decompression, allocates memory for the image data, reads the scanlines, adjusts the color data if necessary, and sets the decoder statistics.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the decoder structure

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the input stream from which the JPEG data is read

parameters.name: st
parameters.description: Pointer to the decoder statistics structure, which is updated by this function

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, otherwise it returns an error code

function.name: jpeg_decoder_get_frame_info

parameters.name: colors
parameters.description: This is the array of colors in the palette.

parameters.name: num_colors
parameters.description: This is the number of colors in the palette.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_PALETTEUNAVAILABLE indicating that the palette is unavailable.

function.name: jpeg_decoder_copy_pixels
function.description: This function copies pixels from a JPEG decoder's image data to a buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the decoder structure

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: Frame number to be decoded

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to a rectangle structure that specifies the portion of the image to copy

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: The byte offset between the beginning of one scan line and the next. This is also known as the pitch of the bitmap.

parameters.name: buffersize

parameters.name: buffer

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: jpeg_decoder_create
function.description: This function creates a JPEG decoder, initializes its properties, and assigns it to the result parameter. It also sets the container format, block format, and class ID of the decoder info structure.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to a decoder_info structure. This function sets its container_format, block_format, and clsid properties.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a decoder structure. This function assigns a newly created jpeg_decoder to this pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. Returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, otherwise returns S_OK.

function.name: dest_mgr_init_destination

parameters.name: cinfo
parameters.description: A pointer to the jpeg compression object

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: dest_mgr_empty_output_buffer
function.description: This function writes the contents of the destination buffer to a stream. If the write operation is successful, it resets the next output byte and free space in the buffer, and returns TRUE. If the write operation fails, it returns FALSE.

parameters.name: cinfo
parameters.description: A pointer to the compression information structure.

function.return_type: boolean, represents whether the write operation was successful or not.

function.name: dest_mgr_term_destination

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: jpeg_encoder_initialize
function.description: This function initializes the JPEG encoder. It sets up the error handling, creates the JPEG compression object, sets the output byte stream, initializes the destination manager, and sets the initialization flag to TRUE.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: A pointer to the encoder interface that is to be initialized

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: A pointer to the stream where the output will be written

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. Returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, otherwise returns E_FAIL

function.name: jpeg_encoder_get_supported_format
function.description: This function checks the supported format for the JPEG encoder. It iterates through the compress_formats array until it finds a matching GUID. If no match is found, it defaults to the first format. The function then updates the pixel_format, bpp, and indexed parameters with the corresponding values from the found format. The indexed parameter is always set to FALSE.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the encoder interface

parameters.name: pixel_format
parameters.description: Pointer to the GUID of the pixel format to be checked and updated

parameters.name: bpp
parameters.description: Pointer to the DWORD to be updated with the bits per pixel of the found format

parameters.name: indexed
parameters.description: Pointer to the BOOL to be set to FALSE

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. The function always returns S_OK, indicating success

function.name: jpeg_encoder_create_frame
function.description: This function is used to create a frame for a JPEG encoder. It sets the encoder frame, checks for errors, sets the image properties and starts the compression process.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the encoder interface.

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the encoder frame structure.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, and E_FAIL if an error occurs.

function.name: jpeg_encoder_write_lines
function.description: This function encodes lines of an image into JPEG format. It handles RGB swapping if necessary and writes the encoded data into the JPEG structure. If an error occurs during the process, it frees the allocated memory and returns an error code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the encoder structure which contains the necessary information for encoding

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the image data to be encoded

parameters.name: line_count
parameters.description: The number of lines in the image data to be encoded

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: The stride size of the image data, which is the number of bytes from the start of one line of image data to the start of the next line

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, E_FAIL if an error occurs during the process, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: jpeg_encoder_commit_frame
function.description: This function commits a frame to the JPEG encoder. It sets up a jump buffer for error handling, assigns the buffer to the encoder's client data, and then finishes the compression process.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the encoder structure that is being used for the JPEG encoding process.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_FAIL if an error occurs during the operation.

function.name: jpeg_encoder_commit_file
function.description: This function commits a jpeg encoder file.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface for the encoder structure.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK indicates success.

parameters.description: This is a pointer to the encoder structure that is to be destroyed.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to an encoder_info structure where the function sets various encoder options.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an encoder structure. The function assigns the created JPEG encoder to this pointer.
